title: DLSA Ujjain Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 170 Para Legal Volunteer Posts
description: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA Ujjain) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of 170 Para Legal Volunteer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the 10th Pass can grab this chance and apply for the DLSA Ujjain Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply offline before the last date of application....
